headline: Budget workshop on department budgets, a three-year Pelham dispatch contract renewal, and using fund balance to offset the 2026 tax rate.
summary: Officials will review budgets for several town departments. They will also discuss the Pelham dispatch contract, Recreation ordinance changes, and using unassigned fund balance to offset the tax rate.
items: Budget workshop reviewing department budgets, including Cable, Library, Recreation, Senior Affairs, Sewer Fund, Solid Waste, and Town Clerk / Tax Collector
Approve a three-year renewal of the intermunicipal agreement for Pelham dispatch services
Discuss and schedule a public hearing on amending Town of Londonderry Recreation Ordinances
Discuss and consider using Unassigned Fund Balance to offset the 2026 tax rate
location: Moose Hill Council Chambers, 268B Mammoth Road, Londonderry, NH 03053

Londonderry Town Council Meeting 
Monday, November 16, 2026, 6 p.m., Moose Hill Council Chambers
CALL TO ORDER
PUBLIC COMMENT
BOARD APPOINTMENTS & REAPPOINTMENTS
None
PUBLIC HEARING
None
NEW BUSINESS
Budget Workshop - Department budgets to be reviewed
a. Cable 
b. Library 
c. Recreation 
¡ Recreation Revolving Fund
d. Senior Affairs 
e. Sewer Fund 
f. Solid Waste 
g. Town Clerk / Tax Collector
Budget documents and related information are available on the TOWN'S BUDGET WEBPAGE .
Approve the Intermunicipal Agreement for Pelham Dispatch Services.
(Fire Chief James Young)
The Town of Londonderry is currently contracted by the Town of Pelham to provide emergency dispatch services. The 
current contract expires on January 1, 2027. The Fire Department is requesting that the Council approve a renewal of the 
contract for three years.
1. 2026-11-16 COVER SHEET _PELHAM DISPATCH CONTRACT.PDF
2. PELHAM FIRE DISPATCH CONTRACT FY28 TO FY30.PDF
Discuss & schedule a public hearing to consider amending the Town of Londonderry Recreation Ordinances.
(Recreation Director Doug Cole and Administrative Services Director Kirsten Hildonen)
The Recreation Department is currently updating their facility use agreements and, in the process of doing so, has 
identified parts of the Town ordinances relating to the Recreation Department that need to reflect current practices. 
These updates clarify roles, combine two separate ordinances on Recreation facilities into one, and provide minor 
updates to processes.
1. 2026-11-16 COVER SHEET_RECREATION ORDINANCES.PDF
2. 2026-11-16 CHAPTER 130 PARKS AND RECREATION FACILITIES.PDF
Discuss and consider the use of Unassigned Fund Balance (UFB) to offset the 2026 tax rate.
(Finance Director Justin Campo)
Discuss the Town ’s current Unassigned Fund balance level and review the 2026 preliminary tax rate to discuss and 
determine potential use of fund balance to offset the tax rate.
1. 2026-11-16 COVER SHEET_USE OF UFB.PDF
2. UNASSIGNED FUND BALANCE ANALYSIS.PDF
